content.expected_result: Slide retains exact r3; historical baseline admission requires an explicit saved view.
preconditions: Use a format-2 code-free proposal; retain the original exact content in a real Git commit, and likewise commit the implemented value before proposing a successor.

steps.action: Edit current store content to implemented with exact evidence at lines 4-6 and a delivery commit; retry the identical command. Compare the committed original proposal.
steps.expected_result: Equal content replays. Current content records delivery repository/commit and pinned evidence; the original proposal remains available from its real Git commit.

steps.action: Propose successor content under the same stable identity, first with the original proposed digest as baseline, then with the committed implemented digest.
steps.expected_result: The proposed baseline is refused; the exact implemented baseline is accepted without authoring a Saga parent graph.

steps.action: Pin the intended current successor digest from a slide and query it. Attempt an older implemented digest without its required saved view.
steps.expected_result: The slide retains the selected exact content digest; historical admission requires explicit saved Git context and never substitutes current content.

content.title: Record implementation while preserving the committed proposal
